task.title: Navigate the eight Guided editor steps
task.shortdesc: Use eight task-first steps after preparation has created a saved profile.

prereq.p: Open a saved profile in Guided editor from Library, creation, or duplicate preparation.

context.p: The editor header displays the selected schema, preset, and CIS baseline as read-only facts. Change those choices only through a new preparation action or explicit schema conversion. The editor contains eight steps; each policy family has one Guided owner.

image.alt: Guided editor showing read-only schema, preset, and CIS baseline facts with the eight-step navigation.
Guided Step 6 showing AMO search and manual extension rule entry.

step.cmd: Use Step 1, Browser, network & search, for browser behavior, network access, and search.

info.p: Expected result: browser and network defaults are grouped without URL/site or certificate controls.

step.cmd: Use Step 2, URLs, sites & navigation, for homepage, startup, permitted or blocked sites, handlers, and managed bookmarks.

info.p: Expected result: navigation values are reviewed together.

step.cmd: Use Step 3, Security & privacy, for privacy controls, permissions, cookies, cleanup, DNS, and hardening posture.

info.p: Expected result: privacy decisions remain separate from certificate trust.

step.cmd: Use Step 4, Certificates & trust, for certificate references, enterprise-root choices, authentication, and security devices.

info.p: BPM stores literal references and does not read certificate or device contents.

step.cmd: Use Step 5, Users, language & sync, for the user-facing identity, language, and synchronization controls supported by the schema.

info.p: Expected result: these controls do not duplicate extension or site rules.

step.cmd: Use Step 6, Extensions, for allowed, blocked, installed, locked, and update rules.

info.p: AMO search is optional and explicit; manual GUID and validated install-URL entry remain available when it is unavailable.

step.cmd: Use Step 7, AI, only for supported Firefox AI and smart-feature policies.

info.p: Expected result: unsupported controls remain unavailable for the selected schema.

step.cmd: Use Step 8, Review & export, to resolve attention items, validate, save, and export.

info.note: A schema warning, raw fallback, CIS manual-review item, or conversion blocker needs a visible review decision; it is not silently repaired by changing another step.

result.p: You can locate each Guided policy family and distinguish the read-only baseline facts from editable settings.

postreq.p: Recovery: use the stepper, setting search, or Review jump if a setting is in the wrong context. For a schema change, save or deliberately discard current edits, request an explicit read-only conversion preview, and apply only an applicable current plan.
